---
# The apa-note of a plain markdown table, written with markdown in it.
#
# Should: keep the emphasis, the bold and the code of the note in every
# format.
#
# Used to: keep them in typst only. Quarto rebuilds a markdown table's
# attributes from its caption, which flattens the note, and only
# formattypst.lua read the copy of the note kept as it was written.
title: "A Table Note With Markdown"
shorttitle: "Table Note"
author:
  - name: A B
    corresponding: true
    email: a@b.edu
    affiliations:
      - name: X
format:
  apaquarto-html: default
  apaquarto-docx: default
  apaquarto-typst: default
  apaquarto-pdf: default
---

| A | B |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2 |

: A table. {#tbl-fmt apa-note="Zqnote with *zqemph*, **zqbold** and `zqcode`."}
